Lauren / team — pulling a proposed redline together. High-level notes for Ari/ProspectCo:

- Mutual publicity: we prefer a mutual clause where both parties may reference the relationship for marketing purposes, subject to approval rights.
- Approval windows: suggest 7 business days for press releases; 3 business days for short-form marketing quotes. This protects both teams while keeping timelines tight.
- Embargoed launches / pilots: include an explicit carveout allowing the customer to request an embargo period (we typically accept up to 14 days in enterprise launches by exception).
- Logo usage: allow web and limited marketing materials, with a requirement to follow Redwood brand guidelines and only use approved logo assets.
- No endorsement: add a short sentence preventing implication of endorsement beyond the relationship.

Suggested exact language (to insert into Order Form):
"Mutual Publicity: Each party may use the other party's name and marks to identify the existence of the business relationship in marketing materials, subject to prior written approval which shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed. Customer shall provide a final draft of any press release or case study to Redwood at least seven (7) business days prior to publication for review and approval. For short marketing quotes and testimonials, Redwood shall provide approval or requested edits within three (3) business days from receipt. Either party may request an embargo for sensitive product launches; such requests shall be reasonably considered and may be granted for up to fourteen (14) days by exception. All use of Redwood trademarks and logos must comply with Redwood's brand guidelines and approved asset files. Neither party shall state or imply any endorsement by the other beyond the scope of the agreed relationship."

I've attached a redlined pdf showing where this inserts into MSA/Order Form (redline_suggestions_msav2.pdf). If Ben has preferred wording for quotes, I can tighten the 3-day turnaround to explicit approval mechanics.

--

Great — copying the marketing guidance here so we have a single source:

- Approved use cases: website partner page, joint press release, case study PDFs, and customer quotes in sales decks.
- Prohibited use: co-branded product screenshots implying integrated product functionality without separate integration docs.
- Asset delivery: Redwood will provide high-resolution logo files and a short style sheet.
- Quote sign-off flow: Customer provides the proposed quote text and final draft of release. Redwood will (a) confirm factual accuracy within 1 business day and (b) provide marketing sign-off within 3 business days unless material edits are requested.

Proposed concise quote clause to insert: "Customer will provide any proposed quote or testimonial in email or doc form; Redwood will confirm factual accuracy within one (1) business day and provide marketing approval or suggested edits within three (3) business days."

Also attaching a lightweight logo spec and PNG asset for reference (logo_guidelines_v1.png). Happy to adapt if ProspectCo has specific brand constraints.

Thanks — Ben

1) For this launch we need an embargo period of 14 days post-internal launch (ProspectCo will provide internal launch date to Redwood). Your clause's allowance for up to 14 days works if we add explicit reference to 'post-internal launch date' — can you add that qualifier?
2) For quotes, can we extend the quote approval window to 5 business days for enterprise stakeholders to confirm wording (this is a one-off ask for this program).

If you accept those two tweaks we'll sign the Order Form and attach our PO. I've attached a signed purchase order stub for reference (signed_po_23498.pdf).

On the embargo tweak: happy to accept your internal approval process but need the explicit 'post-internal launch' reference to ensure our PR team can sequence coverage. For the quote window, if Redwood can commit to a maximum of 5 business days for the current program we can proceed.
